product: Custom AI accelerators (XPUs) co-designed with hyperscalers plus AI Ethernet switching and optics, alongside infrastructure software led by VMware Cloud Foundation, which added VMware Private AI Cloud and AI Factory offerings on Aug 31, 2026.
demand: Demand is strong and accelerating. Q3 FY2026 AI semiconductor revenue was $16.7B, up 221% YoY, and Q4 guidance implies $21.7B, up 236% YoY, backed by multi-gigawatt customer deployment commitments for 2027.
pricing_power: Pricing power looks solid but is not the growth driver. Non-GAAP operating margin held at 66% in Q4 guidance, flat year over year, and free cash flow was 46% of revenue, indicating scale economics rather than price increases.
competition: Nvidia dominates merchant accelerators and networking. Marvell and MediaTek compete for custom ASIC and TPU sockets, AMD is scaling Instinct, and Qualcomm just entered AWS custom silicon. Broadcom's moat is co-design integration and IP, not a general-purpose chip.
team: Hock Tan remains President and CEO and publicly reaffirmed FY2027 and FY2028 AI targets on Sep 14, 2026. Amie Thuener is CFO. Leadership has a record of guiding then meeting or beating, but shares fell over 12% in June 2026 when targets were reaffirmed rather than raised.
market_strategy: Co-design custom XPUs and AI networking with a small set of hyperscale customers, lock multi-year multi-gigawatt commitments, and pair that with VMware infrastructure software for recurring revenue. Broadcom claims a secured supply chain for its FY2027 and FY2028 AI revenue targets.
bull: Q3 FY2026 revenue $29.6B up 86% YoY, AI semis $16.7B up 221% YoY; FY2027 $115B and FY2028 $230B AI targets reaffirmed Sep 14, 2026, with multi-gigawatt Anthropic and OpenAI commitments.
bear: Top five customers ~50% of revenue; stock closed $350.36 Sep 24, 2026, ~29% below high, 63-day momentum -7.35%; D.A. Davidson cut to $350 Sep 3; Reuters Sep 23 China switch curb risk.
falsifier: Any named hyperscaler (Google, Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, ByteDance) publicly pushes out or cancels a custom XPU program before the Q4 FY2026 report.

Leadership raised FY2026 AI guide to $58B from $56B, set FY2027 AI target $115B and a new FY2028 $230B. Aug 31, 2026 VMware Private AI Cloud and AI Factory launches. Form 10-Q filed Sep 10, 2026.

web_demand_price_volume_mix: Volume and demand led. AI semiconductor revenue rose 221% YoY and 54% QoQ, with Q4 guidance implying $21.7B of AI revenue, up 236% YoY. Infrastructure software grew 29% YoY. Non-GAAP operating margin held at 66%, flat YoY, implying pricing and mix are stable rather than the growth driver.
web_suppliers: Broadcom discloses dependence on contract manufacturing, a limited number of suppliers, and an outsourced supply chain in its Sep 2, 2026 release. web_who_loses: Nvidia loses accelerator and networking sockets if custom XPUs win. Marvell loses rival custom-ASIC share. MediaTek competes for Google TPU orders. Cisco and Arista lose Ethernet switching content. AMD loses merchant GPU share. Qualcomm broke into AWS custom silicon on Sep 21, 2026, showing new entrants also take share.
